markets: St. Louis metro (St. Louis City and County, St. Charles, Jefferson, Franklin and Warren counties)
profile.org_note: One head office at 17415 North Outer Forty Road, Chesterfield, MO runs everything; there is no regional or division layer and no division presidents are published. Land sits in a named arm, McBride Land Strategy, led by Jeremy Roth; finance is led by CFO Tony Schutt (since Feb 2026); the CEO, Jake Eilermann, fronts every land announcement. The website's legal lines use 'McBride Homes, Inc.' and 'McBride & Son Homes, Inc.'; Builder ranks the group as McBride & Son Cos.
profile.email_pattern: first initial + last name @mcbridehomes.com (for example jdoe@mcbridehomes.com); one sales-agent address on the site uses first.last instead
profile.summary: Private, family-led St. Louis builder (founded 1946, more than 40,000 homes built) that calls itself Missouri's largest homebuilder; its own Aug 2026 job posting expects about 800 closings in 2026. It builds only in Missouri and is pushing outward from St. Louis along interstates into new small markets (Rolla, Cuba, Sullivan, Jefferson City, Ste. Genevieve) with large master plans it entitles and develops itself. A conventional for-sale builder with an in-house land arm and no publicly disclosed land-bank partner.
